description: This file provides utility functions for retrieving device and platform information on iOS devices, such as OS version, device family, model identifier, app version, and build details. It is used for setting payloads, display, and device status reporting.

methods.name: platformString
methods.description: Returns a string with the OS name ('iOS' or 'iPadOS') and version for gateway/device payloads.

methods.name: platformStringForDisplay
methods.description: Returns a string with OS name and version for display purposes.

methods.name: deviceFamily
methods.description: Returns device family ('iPad', 'iPhone', or 'iOS') for display.

methods.name: modelIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the device's machine model identifier, such as 'iPhone17,1'.

methods.name: appVersion
methods.description: Gets the app's marketing version string, e.g., '2026.2.0' or 'dev'.

methods.name: appBuild
methods.description: Returns the app's build string, e.g., '123'.

methods.name: openClawVersionString
methods.description: Provides a display string for the app version, including build if different from version.
